methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing/subscription page on the accessed date, corroborated with dedicated 2026 pricing-review or trade-press sources where the official page returned a 403/503, geolocated outside the USA (rendering EUR), or sat behind a sign-in/consent wall. All prices are flat per-account per month in USD; consumer plans bundle a fixed number of accounts (noted per tier) rather than charging per seat, so billingModel is flat throughout. HIPAA/BAA are not applicable to consumer music streaming and are recorded null; annualDiscountPct is recorded only where the provider publishes an annual rate, and minutes/calls/overage fields are null for every tier.
